# Shorecrest Digital

> Shorecrest Digital builds client acquisition systems for accounting, bookkeeping and tax firms: Google Ads, Facebook Ads, landing pages, lead screening and follow-up. Founded by Shaun Kaushal (ex-Intuit). Based in Burlington, Ontario.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://shorecrest.co/services): The systems compared by firm size, who runs it and ad channels.
- [LeadFlow, Starter Phase ($50K+)](https://shorecrest.co/services/starter): For firms that run their own marketing. Google and Facebook ads, landing pages, automated email and SMS follow-up, CRM and live support.
- [ClientSurge, Growth Phase ($250K+)](https://shorecrest.co/services/growth): Done-for-you Google and Facebook ads with every lead screened by survey and a real conversation. 10+ qualified consultations a month.
